stories.title: New algorithm improves phase readout for space-based gravitational wave detection
stories.desc: In a study published in Optics Communications, a research group led by Yu Tao from the Changchun Institute of Optics, Fine Mechanics and Physics (CIOMP) of the Chinese Academy of Sciences proposed a new analytical phase readout algorithm for deep frequency modulation interferometry (DFMI).

stories.title: Classical–quantum light interactions could make complex quantum behavior easier to simulate
stories.desc: An international collaboration demonstrates that classical nonlinear dynamics can drive single- and two-photon states to thermalize, opening new avenues for simulating complex quantum many-body systems within accessible optical architectures.

stories.title: How a Metabolic Spark Could Have Jump-Started Life
